overall_reason: A deploy list with glow halos on the status icons, an indigo ring and a glowing indigo Deploy button: the glow is the look, not the task.

score.reason: T-DEFAULT-AGENT fails on the indigo glow; T-SIGNATURE partly passes because state colours (green, grey, red) still read.

findings.where: card border and Deploy button, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: The card has an rgba(99,102,241) ring and outer halo; the 'Deploy' button is #4f46e5 with a 14px rgba(99,102,241,0.8) glow.
findings.before: Indigo glow on the card and the button
findings.after: No glow; a solid button and a plain border
findings.why: Indigo glow is a stock generated-UI accent and adds nothing to a deploy list.

findings.evidence: Each status icon (green globe, grey spinner, red cross) sits in a soft coloured halo.
findings.why: Removing the halos makes state easier to read, so the device is too much (T-REMOVE-DEVICE).

strengths: State colours (green live, grey building, red failed) still carry meaning.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent: no brand authority, audience or overrides were available, so the item was read as an Operate composition (CON-018).
T-RIVAL-NAME cap: the composition names no client, so every placeholder label holds under any rival; the cap at 5 was not applied and the test was used only to spot default copy.
T-IDEA-CARRIES: single composition, there is no second screen to carry the idea.
T-DELETE-PICTURE and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: no lead image and no marketing promise, except where a finding says so.
T-COVER-TEXT: no brand theme or motif to recognise.
The caption above some frames ('Considered composition' / 'Composition problem') is fixture text from the capture host and was not judged.
